name: Salesforce admin/consulting freelance

offer: Remote Salesforce admin, configuration and implementation work
how_it_makes_money: Hourly or retainer billing; the video cites earning $150/hour from home
startup_cost: low (certification and study time; no amount stated)
time_to_first_revenue: about 3 months (three job offers before certification)

Bradley Rice: 'a couple hundred grand a year working 18 hours a week' -AVFpzAfjW0

Client calls are likely, so not fully async
